info.name: Lab 5.1 + Lab 5.2 — Users and Trips MVC API
info.description: Run the entire collection in order against a running server. Covers Users CRUD, validation, IDs, deletion and uniqueness; Trips public reads, role middleware, validation, mutation safety, admin CRUD, both route aliases, unequal/equal comparisons and unknown IDs. Temporary users and trips are deleted at the end; starting records are preserved. Uses only local collection variables for fixtures.

exec: pm.test("Users are an array with only the required fields", () => { pm.expect(users).to.be.an("array"); users.forEach(user => { pm.expect(Object.keys(user).sort()).to.eql(["email", "id", "name"]); pm.expect(user.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(user.name).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(user.email).to.be.a("string"); }); });

pm.test("Create returns trimmed fields and a positive ID", () => { pm.expect(Object.keys(user).sort()).to.eql(["email", "id", "name"]); pm.expect(user.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(user.name).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(user.email).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(user.id).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(user.name).to.eql("Sara"); pm.expect(user.email).to.eql("sara@example.com"); });

item.name: 09. Users: created user appears in list

exec: pm.test("Created user is listed", () => { const user = pm.response.json().find(user => user.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("userId"))); pm.expect(user).to.eql({id:Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("userId")),name:"Sara",email:"sara@example.com"}); });
pm.test("ID retained and both fields updated", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({id:Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("userId")),name:"Sara Updated",email:"sara.updated@example.com"}));

item.name: 20. Users: invalid update did not change data
26. Users: repeated deletion is not found
27. Users: new ID is unique after deletion

exec: pm.test("New ID does not reuse deleted ID", () => { pm.expect(user.id).to.be.above(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("userId"))); pm.expect(Object.keys(user).sort()).to.eql(["email", "id", "name"]); pm.expect(user.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(user.name).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(user.email).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Temporary users cleaned up and invalid requests made no additions", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("usersBaseline"))));
pm.test("Public GET returns trips", () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("success"); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: 33. Trips: role must be exactly admin
48. Trips: forbidden and invalid requests change nothing

exec: pm.test("Created trip has expected fields", () => { pm.expect(trip.id).to.be.a("number").and.above(0); pm.expect(trip.destination).to.eql("Postman Rome"); pm.expect(trip.country).to.eql("Italy"); pm.expect(trip.cost).to.eql(500); });

item.name: 50. Trips: admin creates second fixture via API alias

exec: pm.test("Created trip can be retrieved without a role", () => { const trip = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(trip.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("tripId1"))); pm.expect(trip.destination).to.eql("Postman Rome"); });

pm.test("Unequal costs are compared correctly", () => { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.destination1).to.eql("Postman Rome"); pm.expect(data.destination2).to.eql("Postman Madrid"); pm.expect(data.costDifference).to.eql(250); pm.expect(data.cheaperDestination).to.eql("Postman Rome"); });

item.name: 53. Trips: reversed comparison via short alias

exec: pm.test("Comparison keeps an absolute difference", () => { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.costDifference).to.eql(250); pm.expect(data.cheaperDestination).to.eql("Postman Rome"); });

item.name: 55. Trips: reject comparison with same IDs
56. Trips: reject comparison with string IDs
57. Trips: reject comparison with zero ID
58. Trips: reject comparison with fractional ID
59. Trips: reject comparison with missing ID
61. Trips: comparisons never mutate the array
63. Trips: invalid update preserves original cost

exec: pm.test("Trip cost updated", () => { const trip = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(trip.id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("tripId2"))); pm.expect(trip.cost).to.eql(500); });

pm.test("Neither destination is cheaper for equal costs", () => { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.costDifference).to.eql(0); pm.expect(data.cheaperDestination).to.eql(null); pm.expect(data.message).to.match(/neither.*cheaper/i); });
pm.test("Temporary trips cleaned up and original records preserved", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.eql(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("tripsBaseline"))));
